UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and preferences for MONO-TRANSCODER.

uid.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: The display name of the user.

photoURL.description: Profile avatar URL from Google Sign-In.

favoriteTools.description: Comma-separated list of pinned tool IDs.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII record storing the user's verified email address.

uid.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

email.description: Verified email address of the user.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the private info was last updated.

UserSignature.title: UserSignature
UserSignature.description: Saved digital signature template created by an authenticated user for reuse in Sign PDF.

uid.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID of the signature owner.

sigId.description: Unique identifier of the saved signature document.

label.description: Human-readable label for the saved signature.

dataUrl.description: Transparent PNG data URL of the processed signature.

sigMode.description: Creation mode of the signature (DRAW, TYPE, or UPLOAD).

inkColor.description: Hex color of the signature ink.

typedName.description: Typed text if created in TYPE mode.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the signature was saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the signature was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile and tool preferences keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/private/{infoId}.description: Isolated subcollection storing private PII (email) accessible exclusively by the owner.

/users/{userId}/signatures/{signatureId}.description: Subcollection storing a user's saved PDF signatures for future reuse across sessions.
